MDG.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
The AI agent works inside customs invoice control, recorded under sector systems.

facts.fact: Madagascar's customs directorate says it launched on 7 October 2025 the generative-AI agent SVO, which automatically analyses invoices and detects manipulations, inconsistencies and false invoices to strengthen the fight against fraud.

systems.owner: Direction générale des douanes; developed by CEDIA

MDG.note: The document names CEDIA as developer but does not say where it is based or that the model was built in the country.
